elevate.move: Let the tape travel: the peel-to-DONE that drives the stations also runs when a claim-path tab is chosen (WHO tapes peel in order), when the dent check lights a route and when a photo slot fills, so 'you hear from us at every step' moves wherever the visitor acts.

Give the scroll one shape: fuse the end of the stations and the gloss photo into a single edge-to-edge DONE moment (the drawn door resolves into the real finish), add a quiet paper breath before the yellow claim band, and replace the equal 3x3 services with a taped work-order board where crash work is large and small jobs are a ruled list.
